abstract: ABSTRACT Nutrition security is an emerging concept lacking a consensus definition, conceptualization, or standardized measure. This perspectives manuscript synthesizes findings from two previously published analyses to assess the feasibility of using available measures of key dimensions of nutrition security from two Consumer Food Data System (CFDS) datasets: the 2012–2013 National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey (FoodAPS) and the 2007–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey/Flexible Consumer Behavior Survey (NHANES/FCBS), in deriving a measure of nutrition security aligned with the U. S. Department of Agriculture's definition. This study highlights methodological considerations, strengths and limitations of the two datasets for developing nutrition security metrics, and informs future research on standardized measurement for national nutrition monitoring.
abstract_zh: 摘要 营养安全是一个新兴概念，目前缺乏共识性的定义、概念化或标准化衡量方法。本观点性文章综合了两项先前发表的分析结果，评估利用消费者食品数据系统（CFDS）两个数据集中的关键营养安全维度可用指标来推导与农业部定义相符的营养安全衡量指标的可行性，这两个数据集分别是2012-2013年全国家庭食品获取与购买调查（FoodAPS）和2007-2018年全国健康与营养检查调查/灵活消费者行为调查（NHANES/FCBS）。本研究强调了在开发营养安全指标时的方法学考量、两个数据集的优势与局限性，并为未来国家营养监测标准化测量的研究提供参考。
title: Measuring Nutrition Security Using the Consumer Food Data System Datasets
title_zh: 使用消费者食品数据系统数据集衡量营养安全

journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Betting Against the Crowd: Option Trading and Market Risk Premium

abstract: We reappraise the Arrow problem by studying the aggregation of choice functions. We do so in the general framework of judgment aggregation, in which choice functions are naturally representable by specifying, for each menu A and each alternative x in A , whether x is choosable from A , or not. Our framework suggests a natural strengthening of Arrow’s independence condition positing that the collective choosability of an alternative from a menu depends on the individual views on that issue, and that issue alone. Our analysis reveals that Arrovian impossibility results crucially hinge on what internal consistency requirements we impose on choice functions. While the aggregation of ‘binary’ choice functions, i.e.those satisfying both contraction (\(\alpha \)) and expansion (\(\gamma \)) consistency, is necessarily dictatorial, possibilities in the form of oligarchic rules emerge for path-independent choice functions, that is, when the expansion property \(\gamma \) is replaced by the so-called Aizerman condition. Remarkably, the Arrovian aggregation of choice functions is shown to be almost dictatorial already under property \(\gamma \) alone. When giving up expansion consistency, specific quota rules become possible.
abstract_zh: 我们通过研究选择函数的加总问题，重新审视了阿罗悖论。在判断加总的通用框架下，选择函数可自然地表示为：针对每个菜单A及其中的每个备选项x，明确x是否可从A中被选出。该框架提出了对阿罗独立性条件的自然强化，即集体对某备选项从某菜单中的可选择性，仅取决于个体对该议题的判断，且仅取决于该议题本身。分析表明，阿罗式不可能性结果的关键在于我们对选择函数施加何种内部一致性要求。当加总满足收缩一致性（\(\alpha\)）与扩张一致性（\(\gamma\)）的"二元"选择函数时，结果必然具有独裁性；而对于路径独立型选择函数（即用所谓的艾泽曼条件替代扩张性质\(\gamma\)），则可能出现寡头规则形式的可能性。值得注意的是，仅凭性质\(\gamma\)，阿罗式选择函数加总已近乎呈现独裁特征。若放弃扩张一致性，则特定配额规则成为可能。
title: Arrovian independence and the aggregation of choice functions
title_zh: 阿罗独立性公理与选择函数的加总

abstract: During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to analyze data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. abstract_zh: 2022年6月至8月期间，德国暂时将全国范围内无限制的地方及区域公共交通票价降至每月9欧元。我们研究了这一“9欧元车票”政策引发的出行行为变化及铁路拥堵效应。采用双重差分法和事件研究设计，分析了来自移动网络设备的数据、道路监测站的行政交通流量统计以及列车到达数据。研究发现，铁路出行显著增加，而汽车出行仅出现适度替代。列车出行次数上升约35%，汽车交通量下降1%至5%，其中通勤时段交通减少幅度最小，而周末及前往旅游目的地的休闲铁路出行增幅最大。此外，列车需求激增通过加剧列车延误实质性地恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途列车。福利分析表明，该政策主要充当了生活成本转移的作用，减排效益有限，这意味着政府隐含的二氧化碳减排成本较高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，深度折扣的全国性“任意出行”车票能大幅增加铁路旅行，但在未配套运力扩展的情况下实施，其对汽车向铁路转移的替代作用有限，并会损害服务可靠性。
title: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
title_zh: 近乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式与列车延误的影响

abstract: This note revisits the important question of how fines and imprisonment should be optimally employed. In D’Antoni et al. (2022), a monotone hazard rate condition implies a corner solution for imprisonment in the observable-wealth benchmark when imprisonment disutility is linear. We show that this result is not robust to offenders facing diminishing marginal disutility of imprisonment. The optimal prison term is interior as long as the marginal disutility associated with large imprisonment terms are low and the harms from the offense are large enough to warrant imprisonment. The sentence length thus becomes a genuine policy margin rather than a boundary instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文重访了罚款与监禁如何最优运用这一重要问题。在D'Antoni等人（2022）的研究中，单调风险率条件在监禁负效用为线性时，于可观察财富基准下导致了监禁的角点解。我们证明，当罪犯面临监禁边际负效用递减时，这一结果并不稳健。只要与较长监禁期限相关的边际负效用较低，且犯罪危害足够大以至于需要监禁，最优监禁期限即为内部解。因此，刑期长度成为一个真正的政策边际，而非边界工具。
title: Interior optimal imprisonment under diminishing marginal disutility
title_zh: 边际负效用递减下的最优监禁刑期
